[Your Turn] While your opponent has a suspended Digimon in play, this Digimon gains [Security Attack +1]. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

489997.Description: [On Play] Look at the top card of your security stack. You may add that card to your hand to trigger [Draw 1]. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

490218.Description: [On Deletion] Trigger "Draw 1". (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

490363.Description: [All Turns] When a player uses an Option card, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory.
490363.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

490364.Description:
[Your Turn] When one of your blue Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Tamer to give that Digimon +1000 DP for the turn.
[On Play] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Vee] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
490364.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

490366.Description: [Your Turn] All of your Digimon with [Tyrannomon] in their names gain "Piercing". (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) [Your Turn] When digivolving one of your Digimon into a Digimon card in your hand with [Tyrannomon] in its name, you may suspend this Tamer to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 1.
490366.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

493729.Description: [On Play] Trigger [Draw 1]. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

493742.Description:
[On Play] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, trigger [Recovery +2 (Deck)]. (Place the top 2 cards of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[When Attacking] You may play 1 yellow level 3 Digimon card from your hand without paying its memory cost.

501767.Description: [When Attacking] Gain 3 memory. At end of turn, lose 3 memory.

501768.Description: [When Attacking] Gain 3 memory. At end of turn, lose 3 memory.

501769.Description: [When Attacking] Gain 3 memory. At end of turn, lose 3 memory.

503322.Description: [Main] Gain 2 memory. At end of turn, lose 2 memory.

517148.Description: [On Play] Return 1 Digimon card with [Agumon] in its name from your recycle bin to your hand.

518942.Description:
[Piercing] (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[All Turns] When another Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory for each Digimon deleted.

527810.Description: [On Play] Trigger [Recovery +1 (Deck)]. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
527810.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for every 3 security cards you have.

528293.Description: [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains [Security Attack -2] (This Digimon checks 2 fewer security cards) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
528293.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, you may play 1 yellow level 3 Digimon card from your hand without paying its memory cost.

528294.Description: [When Digivolving] Trigger [Draw 2]. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, trash 2 cards in your hand.
528294.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use an Option card, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.

535280.Description: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Chuumon] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.

535899.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your main phase, trigger [Draw 1]. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

542106.Description: [All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory except with Tamer effects.

629936.Description:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set your memory to 3.
[Your Turn] All of your red Digimon with 4 or more digivolution cards gain [Security Attack +1] (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card).
629936.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
